head_commit.message:
fix(runtime): include the production Memories intent adapter

Include the adapter in ordinary DomainService output and pass its factory
assembly to SDK catalog registration.

Enroll DomainService tests in the unit inventory and strict coverage
contract so hosted CI runs the production discovery regression with its
TRX, assembly source scope and unchanged coverage threshold.
Use the genuine Builds 4.44.4 preparation catalog.
